Presenting the Full Video of “Yaalalo Yaalalo” from Irumudi, featuring Ravi Teja, Priya Bhavani Shankar, and Baby Nakshatra.
With music by GV Prakash Kumar, vocals by Hesham, and lyrics by Shiva Nirvana, this beautiful song captures the warmth and emotion of a special bond.
Enjoy the soulful music, charming visuals, and wonderful performances in Yaalalo Yaalalo from Irumudi.
Song Name: Yaalalo Yaalalo
Music by G V Prakash Kumar
Singer : Hesham Abdul Wahab,sadhika K.R
Lyrics :- Ananth Sriram
